name: crm-employees-multi-select-table-v9
title: CRM Employees Table (Multi-select Filters) (v9)
description: The CRM employees table with multi-select department and status filters, live option counts from the faceted model, a reset button, density toggle, search, sorting and pagination.

files.content:
export type Department =
  | 'Engineering'
  | 'Design'
  | 'Sales'
  | 'Marketing'
  | 'Finance'
  | 'People Ops'
  | 'Support'

export type EmployeeStatus = 'Active' | 'Remote' | 'On leave' | 'Probation'

export type Employee = {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
  department: Department
  status: EmployeeStatus
  location: string
  manager: string
  /** ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) */
  hireDate: string
  salary: number
  /** 1–5 */
  performance: number
}

export const departments: Department[] = [
  'Engineering',
  'Design',
  'Sales',
  'Marketing',
  'Finance',
  'People Ops',
  'Support',
]

export const statuses: EmployeeStatus[] = [
  'Active',
  'Remote',
  'On leave',
  'Probation',
]

const roles: Record<Department, string[]> = {
  Engineering: [
    'Staff Engineer',
    'Frontend Engineer',
    'Backend Engineer',
    'Engineering Manager',
  ],
  Design: ['Product Designer', 'Design Lead', 'UX Researcher'],
  Sales: ['Account Executive', 'Sales Development Rep', 'Sales Director'],
  Marketing: ['Content Strategist', 'Growth Marketer', 'Brand Manager'],
  Finance: ['Financial Analyst', 'Controller', 'Payroll Specialist'],
  'People Ops': ['Recruiter', 'HR Business Partner', 'People Ops Lead'],
  Support: ['Support Specialist', 'Customer Success Manager', 'Support Lead'],
}

const baseSalary: Record<Department, number> = {
  Engineering: 118000,
  Design: 98000,
  Sales: 86000,
  Marketing: 82000,
  Finance: 90000,
  'People Ops': 78000,

}

// Deterministic so the docs preview (and SSR) renders the same rows every time.
function build(count: number): Employee[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const department = departments[(i * 3 + 1) % departments.length]
    const deptRoles = roles[department]
    const first = firstNames[i % firstNames.length]
    const last = lastNames[(i * 7 + 3) % lastNames.length]
    const year = 2016 + ((i * 5) % 9)
    const month = ((i * 7) % 12) + 1
    const day = ((i * 11) % 27) + 1
    const hireDate = `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`
    const onProbation = year === 2024
    const status: EmployeeStatus = onProbation
      ? 'Probation'
      : i % 11 === 0
        ? 'On leave'
        : i % 4 === 0
          ? 'Remote'
          : 'Active'
    const seniority = 2025 - year

    return {
      id: String(i + 1),
      name: `${first} ${last}`,
      email: `${first}.${last}@acme.co`.toLowerCase(),
      role: deptRoles[i % deptRoles.length],
      department,
      status,
      location: locations[(i * 5 + 2) % locations.length],
      manager: managers[department],
      hireDate,
      salary: baseSalary[department] + seniority * 2400 + ((i * 1370) % 9000),
      performance: onProbation ? 3 : ((i * 5) % 4) + 2,
    }
  })
}

export const employees: Employee[] = build(48)

// Shared TanStack Table v9 feature registration used by every /v9 demo page.
// Registers stockFeatures plus every row-model factory and the full built-in
// fn registries, so v9 pages behave like v8's "everything is bundled" default.
// A real app should trim this to only the features/row models it actually
// uses (see the migrate-v8-to-v9 skill shipped in the package) for smaller
// bundles — this file favors parity over tree-shaking.
import {
  aggregationFns,
  createExpandedRowModel,
  createFacetedMinMaxValues,
  createFacetedRowModel,
  createFacetedUniqueValues,
  createFilteredRowModel,
  createGroupedRowModel,
  createPaginatedRowModel,
  createSortedRowModel,
  filterFns,
  sortFns,
  stockFeatures,
  tableFeatures,
} from '@tanstack/react-table'

export const v9Features = tableFeatures({
  ...stockFeatures,
  filteredRowModel: createFilteredRowModel(),
  sortedRowModel: createSortedRowModel(),
  paginatedRowModel: createPaginatedRowModel(),
  expandedRowModel: createExpandedRowModel(),
  groupedRowModel: createGroupedRowModel(),
  facetedRowModel: createFacetedRowModel(),
  facetedUniqueValues: createFacetedUniqueValues(),
  facetedMinMaxValues: createFacetedMinMaxValues(),
  filterFns,
  sortFns,
  aggregationFns,
})

export type V9Features = typeof v9Features
